name: Mentra Miniapp Store
description: Discover, install, update, and manage Mentra miniapps.

actions.description: Check the Store catalog and install every eligible update owned by this Store.

Search the Mentra Miniapp Store. Use when the user asks what miniapps are available or wants a miniapp for a task. Returns compatible catalog results with package names, installation state, and whether a beta offer is installable yet.

query.description: Optional natural-language search, such as 'navigation', 'record meetings', or 'camera'. Omit to browse featured miniapps.

limit.description: Maximum results from 1 through 10. Defaults to 5.

actions.description: Get authoritative Mentra Miniapp Store details for a package, including its description, permissions, hardware compatibility, release track, and installation state. Use before answering detailed questions about a miniapp.

packageName.description: The exact package name returned by search_miniapps.

actions.description: Install a miniapp from the Mentra Miniapp Store. Use when the user asks to install a specific installable result. Pass only the exact package name; the Store resolves and validates the current compatible release. A beta-only offer must first be joined in the Store.

packageName.description: The exact package name returned by search_miniapps.

actions.description: Update an installed miniapp to the current compatible Mentra Miniapp Store release. Use when the user asks to update a specific miniapp.
